note: Synthetic Taglish reports for the five-report model test (python -m silong.bench) and tests/test_bench.py. Not real people or places. Do not reuse the few-shot examples in silong/extract.py here.

reports.text: Paki-rescue po yung pamilya sa tapat ng bahay namin sa Sitio Malinis, Brgy. Bagong Silang. Apat sila nasa second floor, may buntis. Hanggang dibdib na ang baha.

fields.summary: A family of four including a pregnant woman is trapped on a second floor by chest-high flood.

reports.text: Nandito kami sa Gym ng evacuation center. Dalawa kaming nahiwa sa yero habang naglilinis, dumudugo pa yung kamay ko.

fields.injury_note: cuts from metal sheet, hand still bleeding
fields.summary: Two people in the gym were cut by metal sheeting while cleaning; one hand is still bleeding.

reports.text: Sa Room 7 po ng evacuation center, tatlo kami dito. Yung lolo namin 80 years old, ubos na yung maintenance na gamot niya para sa high blood.

fields.summary: Family of three in Room 7; their 80-year-old grandfather has run out of blood pressure medicine.

reports.text: Taga-covered court po kami sa evacuation center, walo kami dito. Kulang na po ang kumot at banig, malamig na sa gabi.

fields.summary: Eight people at the covered court need more blankets and sleeping mats; nights are cold.

reports.text: Update lang po: nakarating na kami ng pamilya ko dito sa evacuation center, nasa Room 2 kami. Okay naman kami lahat, salamat po.

fields.summary: Reporter's family arrived safely at the evacuation center and is in Room 2; all are okay.
